title: Place ESP32 and set power rails
description: Mount the ESP32 DevKit V1 on the breadboard and establish common rails.
instructions: Insert ESP32 across the breadboard center gap. Create a common GND rail. Keep 5V and 3.3V nets separate.
notes: ESP32 GPIO pins are 3.3V-only. Never feed 5V directly into GPIOs.

title: Wire DS18B20 power safely at 3.3V
instructions: Connect DS18B20 VCC to ESP32 3V3 and DS18B20 GND to common GND rail.
notes: This avoids 5V logic on the 1-Wire line.

title: Wire DS18B20 data to GPIO4
description: Connect the temperature data line to firmware pin GPIO4.
instructions: Connect DS18B20 DATA to ESP32 GPIO4.

title: Add DS18B20 pull-up resistor
description: The OneWire bus requires a pull-up to 3.3V.
instructions: Place a 4.7k resistor between DS18B20 DATA and ESP32 3V3.

title: Power ACS712 and share ground
description: ACS712 analog front-end runs from 5V, with common ground.
instructions: Connect ACS712 VCC to 5V rail and ACS712 GND to common GND rail.
notes: Only VOUT goes to ESP32 ADC, and only through divider in next step.

title: Add ACS712 output divider to protect GPIO34
description: Scale ACS712 VOUT before entering ESP32 ADC pin.
instructions: Place 10k from ACS712 VOUT to ADC junction node. Place 22k from ADC junction node to GND. Connect junction node to ESP32 GPIO34.
notes: This is why the BOM includes 22k. Matches firmware PIN_I_SENSE = 34 and ACS divider constants.

title: Build battery voltage divider (input side)
description: Create pack-voltage scaling network for GPIO35.
instructions: Place 68k resistor from BATTERY_POS node to voltage-divider junction node.
notes: Do NOT connect this 68k top node to 5V rail.

title: Complete battery voltage divider (ground leg)
description: Complete 68k/10k divider and route only scaled node to ADC.
instructions: Place 10k resistor from voltage-divider junction node to GND. Connect junction node to ESP32 GPIO35.
notes: Matches firmware PIN_V_PACK_ADC = 35 and divider ratio (68k+10k)/10k.

title: Wire alert LED on GPIO21
instructions: Connect ESP32 GPIO21 to a 130Ω resistor, then to LED anode. Connect LED cathode to GND.
notes: Only red LED is used in this build.

title: Wire buzzer on GPIO26
instructions: Connect ESP32 GPIO26 to 100Ω resistor, then to buzzer positive pin. Connect buzzer negative pin to GND.

title: Connect battery pack sense leads
description: Attach pack leads to measurement front-end nodes.
instructions: Connect battery negative to common GND rail. Connect battery positive only to the BATTERY_POS node (top of 68k resistor).
notes: Never connect battery positive directly to GPIO35 node.

title: 5-minute safety sanity check before power-up
description: Verify no ESP32 input can exceed 3.3V.
instructions: Confirm: DS18 pull-up is to 3.3V, ACS VOUT goes through 10k/22k divider to GPIO34, and battery divider is 68k top + 10k bottom with GPIO35 only at divider junction. Then connect USB and run firmware.
notes: Expected firmware pins: GPIO4 DS18B20, GPIO34 ACS712, GPIO35 Vpack, GPIO21 LED, GPIO26 buzzer.
